selected_clean_recomputed.scope: Frozen runtime load and real validation-member forward; selected clean metrics recomputed from returned predictions, not fresh held-out inference

scope: Three RF control sources from KU Leuven; member-based split, physical session independence not established
known_limitations: Three registered known RF control sources; not general UAV presence detection.
MAT member boundaries do not establish independent physical acquisition sessions.
Synthetic added-noise ratios are not physical acquisition SNR.
Same-user process checks are workflow isolation, not an adversarial security boundary.
deployment_benchmark: A800 only; recorded shared-GPU execution, target NVIDIA desktop benchmark pending
exclusions: Private writing snapshot omits all raw datasets, model weights, optimizer checkpoints, wheels, detailed test shards and 90MB window predictions. Retains member-level evidence and source hashes. Not a complete runnable distribution.
